entities.name: Hieronymus of Rhodes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hieronymus of Rhodes was a Peripatetic philosopher, and an opponent of Arcesilaus and Lyco of Troas. Only a few fragments of his works survive, preserved in the quotations of later writers.
